description: Verify an RFC, optionally against a name + zip. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/verify".

name.description: Optional. Requires `zip`. Registered taxpayer name as it appears in SAT. **Companies:** omit legal-entity suffixes (S.A. de C.V., SAPI de C.V., SOFOM, AC, SC, etc.). **Persons:** legal name with no honorifics. See top-level `Names` section.

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

name: rfc_verify
title: Verify an RFC, optionally against a name + zip
